result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make the experience of another person’s suffering as immediate and undeniable as one’s own.

Not as a metaphor—literally. You would feel the hunger of the person beside you, the fear of the child in the warzone, the loneliness of the elderly neighbor. Not in a way that overwhelms, but in a way that cannot be ignored.

Cruelty would become self-harm. Indifference would become impossible. And every decision—from the personal to the political—would have to pass through the question: *Would I accept this if it were happening to me?*
